name: fshindo
method: Read-only visits to the public Kaggle profile and Competitions pages of ffsscf in the app's built-in browser on 2026-10-30, one page at a time with a pause between them. Text was read from each page; the medal icons were read from the page and from a screenshot of the completed list; the join date was read from the page's join tooltip; the profile picture was compared by eye with the saved portrait file. The older draft of this file was discarded and every claim rebuilt from the live pages. Nothing was downloaded and the saved portrait was left unchanged.
